services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Complete precision manufacturing solutions for industry

torneado-cnc.title: CNC Turning
torneado-cnc.desc: We produce rotational parts with high dimensional precision. Our latest-generation CNC lathes handle diameters from 5mm to 500mm with surface finishes of Ra 0.4 or better.

fresado-cnc.title: CNC Milling
fresado-cnc.short_desc: Complex geometry machining in 3 and 5 axes.
fresado-cnc.desc: Machining of prismatic and complex geometry parts using 3 and 5-axis machining centers. Ideal for molds, dies, prototypes and structural components.

prototipos.title: Rapid Prototyping
prototipos.short_desc: From design to physical part in 48-72 hours.
prototipos.desc: Design validation in record time. Send us your 3D model (STEP, IGES, STL) and in 48-72 hours you have your physical prototype with a complete dimensional report.

produccion.title: Serial Production
produccion.short_desc: Medium and high-volume manufacturing with consistent quality.
produccion.desc: Manufacturing from 10 to thousands of parts with consistent lot-to-lot quality. Control plans, statistical process control (SPC) and specialized packaging.

ingenieria-inversa.title: Reverse Engineering
ingenieria-inversa.short_desc: We recreate parts without drawings from a physical sample.
ingenieria-inversa.desc: When no drawings exist, we recreate the part geometry through high-resolution 3D scanning, generate the CAD model and manufacture exact replicas.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: in Monterrey, Nuevo León
about.story_p1: Founded in 2003 in Monterrey, Nuevo León, we are a family business that grew from a small machine shop to a precision manufacturing plant capable of handling national and international projects.
about.story_p2: Our specialty is turning 3D drawings and models into physical parts with the precision and quality demanded by the automotive, aerospace, and general manufacturing industries. Today we have a team of engineers and specialized technicians committed to excellence.
about.mission: To provide high-precision CNC machining solutions that exceed our customers' expectations in quality, delivery time and personalized service.
about.vision: To be the reference supplier in precision manufacturing in northeastern Mexico, recognized for cutting-edge technology, certified quality and total reliability.
